# Hello!

I am a **Danish-based cognitive-behavioral therapist and researcher** from São Paulo, Brazil.  
I am currently pursuing my PhD in **Psychology and Behavioral Sciences** at **Aarhus University**, where I study the links between **emotion regulation, affect, and cannabis use** in daily life.

My research interests lie in understanding **how emotions, motivation, and context interact to influence substance use and well-being**.  
Currently, I work with **intensive longitudinal (ESM/EMA) data** to investigate within-person mechanisms that shape these processes.

Alongside my research, I am a **licensed psychologist** and **cognitive-behavioral therapist**, passionate about evidence-based practice and the translation of research into clinical work.
